h1.en: 45 kW stays on the Electric 40 vs Diesel 40 Concrete Pump page
h1.zh: 45 kW仍写在电动40和柴油40混凝土泵有何不同这一页

directAnswer.en: Electric 40 and Diesel 40 are Hebei Pinjin Machinery concrete pumps in Xingtai. Electric 40 lists 45 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa and fine-stone 120 m / 360 m. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Three-phase_electric_power.
directAnswer.zh: 电动40和柴油40是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。电动40标出 45 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、细石 120 m / 360 m。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Three-phase_electric_power。

body.en: Downloaded from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Three-phase_electric_power. The image subject is Three phase pole mount transformer closeup (sharpened and releveled). Electric 40 and Diesel 40 are Hebei Pinjin Machinery concrete pumps in Xingtai. Diesel 40's specification table does not list an aggregate-size row. Main unit weight: Electric 40 lists 2300 kg. Diesel 40 lists 2800 kg. Electric 40 lists entries that Diesel 40 does not: Motor power 45 kW. Fine-stone pumping (H / V) 120 m / 360 m. Aggregate-13 pumping (H / V) 40 m / 120 m. Open /en/products/electric-40-concrete-pump/ for Electric 40 and /en/products/diesel-40-concrete-pump/ for Diesel 40.
body.zh: 此图下载自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Three-phase_electric_power。画面内容是Three phase pole mount transformer closeup (sharpened and releveled)。电动40和柴油40是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。最大出口压力：电动40标出 23 MPa；柴油40标出 25 MPa。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上写出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。看电动40请打开 /zh/products/electric-40-concrete-pump/，看柴油40请打开 /zh/products/diesel-40-concrete-pump/。

body.en: Electric 40 lists 45 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa and fine-stone 120 m / 360 m. Theoretical output: Electric 40 lists 21 m³/h. Diesel 40 lists 26 m³/h. The same shown value on a shared label: Hopper capacity is 0.4 m³ on both pages. Hydraulic pump is Kawasaki 112 on both pages. Diesel 40 lists entries that Electric 40 does not: Diesel engine power 4108 / 66 kW. Pumping distance (H / V) 120 m / 360 m. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei.
body.zh: 电动40标出 45 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、细石 120 m / 360 m。外形尺寸：电动40标出 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm；柴油40标出 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm。电动40有、柴油40没有的行：电机功率 45 kW；细石输送（水平/垂直） 120 m / 360 m；13骨料输送（水平/垂直） 40 m / 120 m。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。

body.en: Diesel 40 lists 4108 / 66 kW, 26 m³/h, 25 MPa and distance 120 m / 360 m. Max. outlet pressure: Electric 40 lists 23 MPa. Diesel 40 lists 25 MPa. These are shown entries on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance.
body.zh: 柴油40标出 4108 / 66 kW、26 m³/h、25 MPa、距离 120 m / 360 m。整机重量：电动40标出 2300 kg；柴油40标出 2800 kg。柴油40有、电动40没有的行：柴油机功率 4108 / 66 kW；输送距离（水平/垂直） 120 m / 360 m。如果工况需要这对机型没有写出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

body.en: Both list Kawasaki 112 and a 0.4 m³ hopper. Dimensions: Electric 40 lists 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm. Diesel 40 lists 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other. A shared Kawasaki 112 line does not make the drive or the output the same. If a job needs a figure this pair does not list, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 理论输送量：电动40标出 21 m³/h；柴油40标出 26 m³/h。同一标题下数值相同的有：料斗容积两边都是 0.4 m³；液压泵两边都是 Kawasaki 112。液压泵都写川崎112，并不表示动力或产量相同。

question.en: Does Electric 40 list the same theoretical output as Diesel 40?
question.zh: 电动40和柴油40的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 40 lists 21 m³/h. Diesel 40 lists 26 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Three-phase_electric_power.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动40标出 21 m³/h。柴油40标出 26 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Three-phase_electric_power画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Electric 40 list the same max. outlet pressure as Diesel 40?
question.zh: 电动40和柴油40的最大出口压力一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 40 lists 23 MPa. Diesel 40 lists 25 MPa. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Three-phase_electric_power.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动40标出 23 MPa。柴油40标出 25 MPa。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Three-phase_electric_power画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Electric 40 list the same dimensions as Diesel 40?
question.zh: 电动40和柴油40的外形尺寸一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 40 lists 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm. Diesel 40 lists 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Three-phase_electric_power.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动40标出 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm。柴油40标出 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Three-phase_electric_power画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Why is motor power missing on Diesel 40?
question.zh: 为什么柴油40没有电机功率？

answer.en: The Diesel 40 page does not list that label. Electric 40 lists 45 kW. Leave the missing entry blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Three-phase_electric_power.
answer.zh: 柴油40这一页没有标出这个标题。电动40标出的是 45 kW。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Three-phase_electric_power画面里印出的数字。
